lines.line: Somewhere above the weather, there is a network that nobody ever logged out of.
It begins as a sea of ones and zeros, and every click drops a ripple into it.
When you log in, a figure made of chrome appears, and that figure is you.
You walk along a glass path, past photographs of places you may have forgotten.
At the very end, you meet the one who kept the lights on.
